description: Screens up to 20 crypto addresses (EVM chains, Bitcoin, Solana, Tron, Litecoin, Monero, XRP, Zcash and more; 18 currencies) against the US Treasury OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) digital currency address list. Reports sanction status, list name, SDN program, and source link. Never declares an address clean: reports 'not on the checked lists'. Information only, not financial advice. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
